kind: Predeclared operations and independent literal expectations; not generated files or runtime evidence

comparison.numbers: exact; all selected inputs and results are integers or binary-exact quarters/halves
comparison.types: distinguish blank, number, text, boolean, formula and error; date intent is a styled numeric serial, not a calendar string
comparison.formula: exact invariant formula text without leading equals; preserve host normalization separately
comparison.date: compare numeric Value2, date1904 and styles separately; Text is an observation, not an equality oracle
comparison.caches: compare every tracked formula after each successful operation and after save/reopen; numeric/error/blank cache kind must match

construction.authoring: Three separately specified synthetic business layouts; two sheets per workbook to exercise cross-sheet propagation. Do not derive expectations from Zen or host output.
construction.date_style: Explicit s index and cellXf with applyNumberFormat=1, xfId=0, no child metadata, builtin numFmtId=14; no conditional formatting/tableParts. Record actual exporter metadata; do not silently rewrite unsupported metadata to pass.
construction.calculation: manual, fullCalcOnLoad=0, forceFullCalc=0 initially. Zen preserves workbook.xml/calcPr bytes at every step and save; it must write numeric caches for every changed tracked formula rather than relying on a later Excel recalculation. clear_formula removes f/v/is and cell type while retaining c/r/s; SUM ignores the resulting blank. Existing unchanged formula caches remain numerically exact. Any unexpected nonnumeric dependent cache blocks acceptance.
construction.preservation_probe: Include a separate synthetic customXml text part and owning relationship; assert all unedited parts, styles and workbook metadata byte-for-byte on Zen saves. Native Excel may normalize packages; record that separately.
construction.sealing: Before host or Zen runs, inspect packages/render authored inputs, verify literal initial values/formulas/styles/system, then create a new manifest with SHA256 of plan and all three XLSX. Refuse overwrites. No old res-002-v1 files are modified.

cases.business: Budget variance: planned less actual across payroll, rent and supplies
Two order lines: quantity times unit price and aggregate value
Regular days times daily hours plus overtime; aggregate two employees

execution_protocol: Verify sealed input and plan hashes before each run. Publish source commit, tool/Office versions and input hashes; keep paths/process records/raw host output under target.

For each file run all eight forward operations in one Zen API session. Assert full expected snapshots: expected objects are deltas, absent keys retain previous values. Also assert edited cell value/type/formula, date style/system, dependent caches and calcPr using a separately declared cache policy before acceptance.

After every successful Zen edit, undo to exact prior archive bytes, then redo to exact resulting archive bytes; check revision, dirty, retained memory and history under the existing session contract, without expecting revision to move backwards. Count this separately from native host operations. Save/reopen final state and selected date/formula intermediate states to fresh targets.

After each formula replacement, editing the old reference must not change its removed dependent; editing the new reference must update local and cross-sheet dependents. Clearing formula means remove formula and cached value; it is not retaining the last result as a literal.

For each original input, use three independent owned Excel instances and isolated copies; 3 files times 3 runs, not 27 independent files. Apply equivalent forward operations using Value2/ClearContents/Formula, CalculateFullRebuild per step, record all tracked cells Value2/Formula/Text/errors/date1904 and workbook/application identity.
Excel COM assignments are not native Undo; never use Application.Undo as a substitute for Zen history validation. Close only the owned workbook/instance after checking PID creation time/path.

SaveAs to new targets, close/reopen and inspect formulas/caches/types/system. Input hashes must stay unchanged. Compare Zen and native normalized semantic snapshots against literal expectations as well as each other; preserve every mismatch.
Only select an explicit Office/ONLYOFFICE target for REA when a concrete discrepancy requires investigation; static or downloaded source evidence is not a native run.
remaining_prerequisites: Generate and render three XLSX packages; establish independent valid package identity and manifest before any execution
Verify generated package calcPr/cache serialization against the predeclared construction policy before sealing; do not lower policy after observed failures

Separate executable refusal/history suite: wrong date system, unsupported date style, unknown name, array/external formula, nonfinite input, budget exhaustion, pre-existing output and output lock; retain source/session/old-output bytes on every rejection
Create Zen API runner and native typed operation observer; existing numeric-only CLI/observer do not support this plan as-is
